examples.title: Percentage of a quantity
examples.problem: A school has 1,250 students and 36% of them come by bus. Of the bus users, 40% are in the primary wing. How many primary-wing students come by bus?

examples.title: Percentage change
examples.problem: A bike's mileage drops from 48 km per litre to 42 km per litre. What is the percentage fall?
steps: The fall is 48 - 42 = 6 km per litre.
Divide by the starting value: 6 ÷ 48 = 0.125, so the fall is 12.5%.

examples.title: Successive percentage changes
examples.problem: A price rises by 15% and then falls by 20%. What is the net change?
steps: 1.15 × 0.8 = 0.92, so the final price is 92% of the original.

examples.title: Overlapping groups
examples.problem: Of 600 employees, 55% speak Hindi, 40% speak Tamil and 20% speak both. How many speak neither language?
